newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Dec CPI to fall to 9.9 percent - economist.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Dec CPI to fall to 9.9 percent - economist.

text.p: South African consumer price inflation will probably rise to 9.9 percent in December, according to Johan Roussouw, economist at stockbroker Huysamer Stals.
Commenting on the surprisingly low year-on-year increase of inflation in November, Roussouw said:
"It is very probable that consumer inflation will peak in December 1996. We forecast it to decline to about 5.5 percent in December 1997 to bring about an average 1997 CPI rate of 7.9 percent.

His forecast for 1997 is more optimistic than previous ideas from other economists. A Reuters survey of 28 economists last month forecast an average inflation rate of 8.9 percent in 1997, from 7.5 percent in 1996 and 8.7 in 1995.
